headline: Unitree releases UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 Base checkpoint and fine-tuning code
summary: Unitree's official UnifoLM-WLA repository records a September 28 release of the WLA-1.0 Base checkpoint and fine-tuning code. The current official model repository lists a 12.5 GB safetensors checkpoint under Apache-2.0, while the official guide describes a local episode evaluation path. These artifacts make part of the earlier open-release promise inspectable; they do not establish the reported 64-task performance or broad physical generalization.
